title: Application Cache Entity
description: Common properties shared by all caching applications (Redis, Memcached, Varnish).

listen_address.description: Bind address for the cache service.

listen_port.description: Port the cache service listens on.

eviction_policy.description: Policy when memory is full (e.g., noeviction, allkeys-lru, volatile-lru).

persistence.description: Whether to persist cached data to disk.
